links.comparator_used: AI's initial suggestion alone (before radiographer supervision)
links.outcome: Patient pathway changes and overriding of incorrect AI results under radiographer supervision
links.effect: Radiographer supervision altered the subsequent patient pathway in 20% of cases, with overriding more likely when AI was later found incorrect (false positives or false negatives). Only one patient needing treatment was prematurely discharged.
links.tradeoff: One patient who required treatment was prematurely discharged and was recalled after the radiologist's report.
links.quote: Compared to AI's initial suggestion, radiographer supervision altered the subsequent patient pathway in 20% of the cases, with the likelihood overriding AI being higher when AI results were later found to be incorrect (i.e. false positives or false negatives).
